name: Sight Beyond Sight
body:
Design revelation (scrying); Level 4

CASTING

Casting Time 1 hour

EFFECT

Range see text
Effect magic sensor
Duration 1 min./level
Saving Throw Will negates; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You can observe a creature at any distance. This functions as a scyring spell, except as noted here.

Overload: For every runic charge overloaded into this script, the DC increases by +1.
